articles.title: TTFBは速いのに表示が遅いVercelのページ、関数リージョンが既定のままだった
articles.author: 石井悠汰@製造BT部
articles.accessNote: Complete public article main text read, including code/tables/conditions/results/limitations; images considered through accompanying captions/text only. No independent execution or replication.
articles.factsToPreserve: Next.js 15 App Router on Vercel; API Gateway/Lambda Hono and DynamoDB in AWS Tokyo; rankings show 20 rows. loading.tsx creates a Suspense boundary: shell responds before data retrieval; TTFB covers shell start while response connection remains open for server API fetches. Browser Network does not show the RSC server internal 41 calls. x-vercel-id MISS response had Tokyo edge hnd1 but function iad1 in US East; configured hnd1 at Vercel Root Directory vercel.json and dashboard for older/reverted builds. Inspect both index and index.rsc functions. Rank fetch1 +20rows*2details =41 API calls; concurrency10 still each row has serial daily-aggregate then raw-data lookup. 798KB loaded for20 sparklines. Precompute daily downsampled series max60points, BatchGetItem endpoint fetches daily aggregates/profile together; frontend replaces perrow fetch with1 batched fetch, so total2 calls. Rejected embedding data in148604 ranking items because 10periods*4axes replicate series up to40 places; estimated extra39.7MB/day vs0.38MB/day for daily aggregates, but1call vs2call costs around150ms. Existing WCU rounding remains1 for250to530B items. Baseline TTFB0.45–0.69s, unvisited total1.79–2.74s, revisit0.63–0.83s. Region fix TTFB0.12–0.19s, unvisited0.74–1.53s, revisit0.27–0.58s. After N+1 fix TTFB0.12–0.20s, unvisited0.30–0.77s, revisit0.17–0.45s. Rough2.2to0.5s reception, not measured visible paint. No live site identity or full public experiment code; author deliberately obscures application subject. Do not equate TTFB with response completion, or HTML reception with LCP. Do not generalize numerical speedup to all Vercel apps. Article claims plan region counts; avoid carrying current commercial plan limits without separately verifying official docs.
shortEvidenceAnchors: ブラウザの描画までは含みません。

articles.title: 地球を指でちぎる: 1.6万個の粒の SPH を Web Worker で動かす
articles.topic: Web Workerと粒子法シミュレーション
articles.author: しし屋 まなびラボ
articles.accessNote: Complete public article main text read, including code/tables/conditions/results/limitations; images considered through accompanying captions/text only. No independent execution or replication.
articles.factsToPreserve: CesiumJS educational globe renders earthquake-like tearing with about16000 SPH earth particles; spacing408km, smoothing length1.1spacing, roughly45 neighbors within2h. PREM layer boundaries inner core1221km/coremantle3480km; layer-specific Murnaghan EOS solves gravity-pressure equilibrium; initializes300 damped steps at0.9velocity factor. Track density by continuity equation; direct mass-sum density underestimated free-surface density. Clamp pressure >=0, no tensile force; artificial viscosity alpha1 beta2 converts work to heat. Approximate gravity spherically perfragment,256 radial shells counting enclosed mass instead of allparticle pairs; physicalstep~10s set by11km/s sound speed andspacing. One Web Worker computes physics; main thread draws point shaders. Shared namespace moves from browser window to worker-compatible self. Grabber critical-damping spring; bounded approach8km/s pulling and15km/s moving, first lift to14000km radius then arc, instead of direct chord scraping. Crack detection uses up to6 original neighbor-distance changes >=35%, not absolute displacement which falsely flags global wobble. Ocean separate3600 particles from7000 Blue Marble samples; only exposed hot rock boils water. Calculated centerpressure340GPa, mass5.66e24kg ~5%lighterthanactual. Unbounded grabber originally yielded44km/s and+350000C; capped3km/s healedhole beforevisible; tuned8/15km/s and arclift reducesartefacts. Simplified educational model: nonnegative pressure/no tension makes tearing easy; small rocks really retain shapes. Sphericalgravity andcoarse408km particles are approximations; do not call physically validated geophysics or real-world disaster prediction. 30ms on16corePC is not16thread execution; there is exactly1WebWorker.
shortEvidenceAnchors: 計算は Web Worker 1つで回しています。
